evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Deliver the exact run-specific smoke fixture on a new pull-request branch in the source-configured side repository.
intent.acceptance: Independent source-bound PR/base/head identities and immutable complete Git tree/blob proofs establish a newly added regular smoke-tests/smoke-RUN_ID.txt with exact prescribed content and a native UTC timestamp inside the original run.

evidence.opportunity: One run-specific cross-repository fixture delivery per original workflow run, not each rerun or report.
filters: Retain source-era target ownership; never equate github and githubnext without immutable repository-identity proof.
Only independently acquired PR target/base/head binding and exact immutable file content establish attainment.
Source-repository issues, successful jobs, editable footers and unconsumed patches are discovery or mechanism evidence only.
Unknown retained or deleted history is null, not zero. Known native deliveries may be shown as lower bounds through gaps.
Draft, smoke-test labels, expiry, reporting, costs and contribution attribution are separate safeguards or unmeasured dimensions.
evidence.collection: Replay the sealed public source/discovery archive and any independently acquired target Git receipts offline. Target reads were blocked by public-only authority; no target content was acquired.

model.architecture: Independent exact Git-object proof, source-era target identity and protected original-run binding.
model.recommendation: Do not rate value until authorized independent target receipts exist; preserve every visible evidence gap.

metrics.name: Independently verified fixture deliveries
metrics.formula: Distinct original-run fixtures passing independent target, branch, base absence, Git blob and exact content checks; partial positive count is a lower bound.

metrics.name: Complete verified delivery count
metrics.formula: Verified fixture deliveries only when the entire eligible period and every delivery assessment are independently complete.
